test-work-wo-control.mjs: mock replaced rather than chained context handlers; chain them as Pi does and explicitly select ultracompact instead of inheriting global user mode.

decisions.title: Pin the devDependency to the reviewed release 1.5.0
decisions.rationale: package.json still pins @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 1.4.0 for type checks and tests, while the host now runs 1.5.0 (summary.json installedVersion). The 1.4.0 catch-up adopted the same pin rule. Step CU-01.
decisions.verification: CU-01: npm install --save-dev --save-exact @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@1.5.0 -> package.json devDependency and package-lock.json both 1.5.0 (commit d09de12)

decisions.title: Image resizing now picks the smaller of PNG and JPEG: keep generate_image output PNG
decisions.rationale: 1.5.0 'Fixed resized photos being sent as multi-megabyte PNGs': resizeImage now tries the smaller encoding first (dist/utils/image-resize-core.js `const preferred`); 1.4.0 always took PNG first when no byte budget applied. extensions/work-images.ts fitImage scales every sized generate_image result (Codex draws about 1448x1086 for 800x600) with maxBytes MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, and execute() names the file by the returned mimeType, so a requested out.png can now be saved as out.jpg, and pngSize() then skips the size check. shrinkImage (process_image input) benefits from smaller JPEGs and stays as is. Step CU-02.
decisions.verification: CU-02: node scripts/test-work-compaction-notifications.mjs -> ok; a JPEG resize with a stub converter returns image/png at 800x600, jpegQuality 100 is passed, and a failed conversion keeps the original

decisions.title: Tool argument validation moved to pi-schema (breaking change)
decisions.rationale: Pi now validates tool arguments as plain JSON Schema and coerces loosely typed values for every tool, and drops a null in an optional property whose schema rejects null (pi-schema dist/coerce.js). rg finds no Type.Refine, BigInt, Undefined, Codec or Format.Set in extensions, scripts or hub/src, and no test asserts TypeBox error wording. extensions/ask-user imports @sinclair/typebox, which the 1.5.0 loader still maps (core/extensions/loader.js). Required nullable fields use type unions that accept null; jev_triage state has an empty schema, so coercion passes it through.

decisions.title: Extension update changelogs shown by Pi after a package update
decisions.rationale: Pi reads CHANGELOG.md from an extension package and shows entries newer than the last seen version on the next fresh TUI launch (docs/packages.md 'Show a changelog'). Its parser (dist/utils/changelog.js) matches our `## x.y.z — date` headings and skips `## Unreleased`; every push bumps package.json version, so ce-workflow notes appear once per update. Hub sessions run in RPC mode, where the interactive notice does not show, and the hub keeps its own changelog. Default kept.

decisions.title: ctx.ui.custom() `blocked` option for inline dialogs
decisions.rationale: The option only makes Pi report OSC 7501 program status `blocked` (Rex, iTerm2; docs/terminal-setup.md 'Program status'). The vendored ask-user defaults to overlays, which ignore it; inline list menus in extensions/ask-user/menu.ts could pass it, but this setup is Windows plus the hub, which tracks open questions itself.

decisions.title: pi.exec, setActiveTools order, tool_search ranking, Windows path case and session-write fixes
decisions.rationale: Host fixes that help without code changes: pi.exec output cap and SIGKILL after timeout (plan3.ts and browser-fetch.ts call pi.exec for short commands), no redundant system prompt update when the exposure manager re-sets the same tools in another order, better tool_search and searchTools ranking for tools_enable and codemode, case-insensitive Windows path comparison in Pi, and no lost history after a failed session write.

decisions.title: selfUpdateCommand, keyHint/keyText injection, MarkdownTransformContext ids, responseModel
decisions.rationale: rg finds no use of keyHint, keyText, markdown transforms or responseModel in extensions or hub/src. The hub's Update all runs pi update --all on the pi.dev installer, which needs no custom update command.

decisions.title: Usage.cost.totalFromProvider: keep summed compaction usage correct
decisions.rationale: 1.5.0 adds the boolean Usage.cost.totalFromProvider, true when the total is the provider's billed amount; combined usage counts as provider-reported only when every part is. Two loops add every cost field as a number: extensions/work-models.ts (chunked native summary, around line 1694) and extensions/work-compaction-memory.ts (hybrid memory attempts, around line 251). A true flag becomes 1, and mixed parts stay truthy. Sum only numeric fields and AND the flag. Step CU-04 (found by the plan review).
decisions.verification: CU-04: node scripts/test-work-compaction.mjs -> ok (all-true, mixed and absent addCost cases); node scripts/test-work-compaction-notifications.mjs -> ok (chunked usage keeps the flag true)

decisions.title: Model catalog v2: image-only models are no longer chat models
decisions.rationale: generateImages() in extensions/work-images.ts finds image models with registry.findOfType('image', ...) and only draws with chat models of api openai-codex-responses, so removing image-only models from the chat list changes nothing here.

decisions.title: Verified private workflow generation
decisions.rationale: The official stable release is translated into the complete private nine-workflow generation with no ordinary CE runtime surface.

decisions.title: Session switches with background work now ask stay, take or leave: report a cancelled Plan3 handoff
decisions.rationale: 0.85.0 adds a session_before_switch guard (src/extension/session-switch.js): with queued or running runs, undelivered results or open supervisor questions it asks via ctx.ui.select, and in RPC mode a 60 s timeout cancels the switch. The hub's new_session path already reports `Pi kept the current session.` (hub/src/sessions.ts). Plan3 startFresh (extensions/plan3.ts) ignores ctx.newSession's `{ cancelled }` result, so a refused or timed-out switch leaves the user with no message after the handoff. Step CU-03.
decisions.verification: CU-03: node scripts/test-work-plan3.mjs -> Plan3 command self-checks passed; a cancelled newSession shows "Pi kept this session; the plan is ready · /resume3 <id>"

decisions.title: Workflow children go through a nested subagent_launch tool call
decisions.rationale: 0.85.0 runs a deferred, model-hidden subagent_launch tool before each workflow child so tool_call handlers can block it (src/extension/subagent-launch-tool.js). Every ce-workflow tool_call handler filters on its own tool names (bash, read, intercom, ask_user, subagent), so none blocks it. Changing event.input does not reach the child, because pi-subagents launches from its own args object, so advisor-model.ts cannot pin the oracle model there and keeps its prompt guideline for workflow scripts.

decisions.title: Subagent tools restored after compaction once pi-subagents was reloaded
decisions.rationale: 0.86.0 fix (#3198). Idle sessions in the hub reload onto updated extensions by themselves, so this upstream fix removes a case where subagent and subagents_enable disappeared after a later compaction; nothing to change here.

decisions.title: structured_output checked strictly against outputSchema
decisions.rationale: 0.85.0 validates the model's raw structured_output before Pi coercion. The context-knowledge-discoverer schema (KNOWLEDGE_DISCOVERER_SCHEMA in work-models.ts) uses plain strings, enums and string arrays; a wrong type now fails validation and the child calls again, which is correct.

decisions.title: Resume hardening, waitTool.name, requireLauncher, workflow script sandbox, Herdr and Rex placement fixes
decisions.rationale: ce-workflow registers no bg_wait, sets no launcher or placement, and starts its subagents through spawnSubagentRpc or the subagent tool. Runs started before 0.85.0 cannot be resumed, which only affects runs that were already interrupted.

decisions.title: Top-level context, options, allowMultiple and allowFreeform sent with questions are ignored instead of an error (0.17.2, #88)
decisions.rationale: Upstream dropped the BATCH_ENTRY_FIELDS check because models that echo schema defaults looped on the validation error. Our copy still throws it (extensions/ask-user/index.ts:226, 2619-2623, which also lists initialText). No local or x1600 session hit it yet, but the change is a deletion that removes a retry trap and a divergence from upstream. CU-01.
decisions.verification: node scripts/test-work-ask-user.mjs -> ok (stray top-level context/initialText/allowMultiple with questions runs); node scripts/test-work-ask-remote.mjs -> ok

decisions.title: Single-select rows wrap by terminal columns with pi-tui wrapTextWithAnsi (0.17.2)
decisions.rationale: single-select-layout.ts wrapText counts UTF-16 length, so emoji and CJK options overflow the row width; upstream replaces the 40-line word wrapper with pi-tui's column-aware wrapTextWithAnsi, which index.ts already imports from for truncation. A deletion that fixes wide-character rows. CU-02.
decisions.verification: node scripts/test-work-ask-user.mjs -> ok (emoji and CJK option rows <= width 24 by visibleWidth)

decisions.title: Tern sheet docked in the composer, shortLabel tab labels, README wording (0.17.1, 0.17.2)
decisions.rationale: Tern support was not ported in the 0.17.0 review (UPSTREAM.md); shortLabel only serves Tern tabs and review keys. ce-workflow targets the terminal and the hub.

decisions.title: Mailbox: sends to a disconnected session report that the message waits; the broker stays up while mail waits; late messages emit expired
decisions.rationale: hub-command.ts intercomParkedSessions wakes a parked session before sending and only rewrites error results; a "waiting for reconnect" result is not an error. work-ask-remote.ts sends through intercom:outbox-request and does not read delivery text. No ce-workflow code depends on broker exit timing.

decisions.title: Click to expand or collapse one intercom message in fullscreen mode
decisions.rationale: Terminal display only; the hub renders its own chat.

decisions.title: Inherit pi-goal recovery, stale-context, settings, and documentation fixes
decisions.rationale: Grade: Not-our-problem. Reversibility: Tier 1 package rollback. Bottom line: keep pi-goal 0.54.8 package-owned and make no ce-workflow compatibility adapter. Verified project fit: ce-workflow's coexistence path only reads the canonical custom goal-state entry and sends public /goal pause and /goal resume commands; the installed persistence source still serializes data.goal under customType goal-state, and the public commands remain unchanged. Verified upstream evidence: the installed 0.54.8 README, managing-goals and settings references, package metadata, source, and captured 0.54.4-to-0.54.8 artifact show internal transient-stream classification, stale extension-context cancellation, menu/settings lifecycle, and documentation/build changes while preserving the coexistence surface. Benefit: pi-goal users receive safer recovery and lifecycle behavior without duplicate state ownership. Cost/risk: ordinary upstream regression exposure. Confidence: high. Recommendation: no local adapter.

decisions.title: 4.4.9 tool output and guard changes
decisions.rationale: 4.4.9 changes lsp_navigation's default output to text, rejects unknown severity and read_symbol kind values, routes partial edit applies through Pi's edit tool, and repeats unresolved blockers at the next prompt. ce-workflow calls none of these tools from code: work-compaction.ts and work-models.ts only list the names read_symbol, read_enclosing, module_report and lens_diagnostics, and these names are unchanged. The only ce-workflow write guard (extensions/plan3.ts, around line 1900) handles the write tool for new Plan3 files; the upstream change concerns partial edit batches, and no ce-workflow handler guards edit, so it has nothing to reach.
